findings.issue: Two nested loops are printed as one 'while True' whose head is the inner copy loop: the outer step (12 variables reassigned, a = a + 1) sits after the inner exit, and the outer exit is a test in the middle. findings.rule: Two back edges to one header that belong to different cycles (one through the inner copy step only, one through the outer step) form nested loops: give the inner cycle its own header (a copy of the head block if needed) so that each loop is a separate while; the inner word copy then becomes a copy line.
